name: Hiezu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hiezu village emblem in white: a stylised letter G-shaped device with horizontal strokes at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Hiezu, a village in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1976.

features.role: Hiezu village emblem — a stylised letter G-shaped device with horizontal strokes at the fly
